Metadata.title: About Us - Vocabulary Reminder
Metadata.description: Learn about our mission to help people master new languages through effective vocabulary learning

hero.title: About Vocabulary Reminder
hero.subtitle: Discover how our scientifically-proven spaced repetition system helps you learn and retain new words up to 3x more effectively than traditional methods.

forgettingCurve.title: Ebbinghaus Forgetting Curve
forgettingCurve.description: In 1885, Hermann Ebbinghaus discovered that memory retention declines exponentially over time. However, each review strengthens the memory, making it more resistant to forgetting. Our intervals are precisely timed to counter this curve.

spacedRepetition.title: Spaced Repetition Effectiveness
spacedRepetition.description: Research shows that spaced repetition can increase long-term retention by up to 200% compared to cramming. Our system optimizes these spacing intervals based on cognitive science research.

timing.title: Optimized Timing
timing.description: Our carefully calculated intervals (1h, 3h, 8h, 1d, 3d, 7d) are designed to maximize retention while minimizing the number of reviews needed.

multiChannel.title: Multi-Channel Learning
multiChannel.description: By combining email and Telegram notifications, we ensure you never miss a review session, increasing your learning consistency and effectiveness.

integration.title: Effortless Integration
integration.description: Our system seamlessly integrates into your daily routine, making vocabulary learning a natural part of your day rather than a separate study session.

retention.description: Higher retention rate compared to traditional methods

time.description: Less time spent on vocabulary review
